When I called the practice today to speak to a doctor, I explained that I was attending a funeral and would not be available until after 12pm. Despite this, I was interrupted twice by Lorraine, an “advanced practitioner”.
I have been suffering from a sore throat for over two weeks. I also mentioned that I had recently had a tooth removed, but as soon as this was raised there seemed to be little interest in addressing the sore throat itself. Instead, the focus shifted to redirecting me back to the dentist, despite the dentist having already advised me to contact my GP. This felt like unnecessary deflection rather than an attempt to resolve the issue.
I do not visit this practice often, but this experience left me feeling that my concerns were not taken seriously and that there was a lack of empathy and common sense in the handling of my call.
Having since seen the reviews, it is unfortunate to note a pattern of similar experiences. This is particularly disappointing as there are some good GPs working at the practice who appear to be let down by inconsistent standards of care among some of the staff.",null,[0,234]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twM1ZYVmlNa1EyVVZSbVNIZEJUUzEyU0VWTlVGRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x11e0dbe92f0f1567!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkp3VXViMkQ2UVRmSHdBTS12SEVNUFE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twM1ZYVmlNa1EyVVZSbVNIZEJUUzEyU0VWTlVGRRAB&t=1&_p2-ARKgswZEY1QVlZUlRuaQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjGmOil9q-TAxWzHmMBHYUGBiwQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjGmOil9q-TAxWzHmMBHYUGBiwQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMVJqWm1KaU1WOWZSV2hEYWtGelJVeEdiM0JYWDI5NFpqVkJWVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpUWTBOYVRuZzVkSFpWV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xSeFRHdERNWEJPZURkak5GbFdiekpIUlVwVlQzYxAB",["0x0:0x11e0dbe92f0f1567",null,1764955199235438,1765272260643374,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104628237418097531872/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["nikki govan","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJmR_jXixdX591F5Ms1xIdjvFF44C5atMZ5HOBD5-Vcksay7A=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104628237418097531872?hl=en"],"104628237418097531872",null,15,0,null,[1,4,1],4,["Local Guide · 15 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjGmOil9q-TAxWzHmMBHYUGBiwQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"Edited 3 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I’ve been with this practice for over 30 years, but since lockdown their care has seriously declined.
